title: React Form Compiler
description: Formal compiler for React forms: parse spec → scaffold → implement → test → verify → attest. Validates field alignment with schema and route contract.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract form-spec.json: fields, validation rules, submit route, auth requirement, success/error behavior

pipeline.title: Scaffold
pipeline.description: Generate form component, Zod validation schema, test stub

pipeline.title: Implement
pipeline.description: Write full form with react-hook-form + zod resolver, per-field error display, submit handler, loading/disabled states

pipeline.title: Test
pipeline.description: Write and run unit tests: render, validation errors, submit success, submit error, loading state

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Cross-check form against schema fields, route input contract, and form structural contract

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed form-artifact.json for the registry

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: form-spec.json exists with required fields: name, fields[], submitRoute, auth

gates.title: Schema Valid
gates.description: form-schema.ts exports a valid Zod schema with all declared fields

gates.title: No Any Types
gates.description: No untyped `any` in Form.tsx or form-schema.ts

gates.title: Labels Present
gates.description: Every input field has an associated <label> or aria-label — no unlabelled inputs

gates.title: Error Display
gates.description: Validation errors are displayed per-field (not just console.error or alert)

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/PLACEHOLDER in Form.tsx or form-schema.ts

gates.title: Tests Pass
gates.description: All form unit tests pass with zero failures

gates.title: Submit Handler
gates.description: Form has an onSubmit handler that calls the declared submitRoute — not a no-op or console.log

gates.title: Schema Alignment
gates.description: Form fields must align with schema-artifact.json fields. Schema is source of truth — extra UI-only fields allowed, but data fields must match.

gates.title: Route Alignment
gates.description: Form submit payload must match route-artifact.json input_schema. Route input is the contract — form must satisfy it.

gates.title: Form Contract
gates.description: Form satisfies structural contract: loading state, disabled submit on loading, error boundary, accessible markup

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled React forms

error_codes.RF002: form-schema.ts invalid or missing Zod exports
error_codes.RF005: Input field missing label or aria-label
error_codes.RF009: Form fields conflict with schema-artifact fields
error_codes.RF010: Form submit payload does not satisfy route input schema
error_codes.RF011: Submit handler missing or is a no-op
error_codes.RF012: Form contract violation (loading state, a11y, error boundary)
